setupsnap.gui.title: SetupSnap

setupsnap.gui.apply_confirm:
Apply "%s"?

%s files, %s, saved %s.

Keybinds, sensitivity, video settings and mod configs in the profile are written over the current ones. Replaced files are backed up first, and options.txt is reloaded immediately.

Delete "%s"?

Only the profile file is removed. Your current settings stay untouched.
